listing.name: Blade II: The Return of Evil (blade2-mobile)
listing.summary: Build Blade II: The Return of Evil for Apple silicon Mac from your own Switch game. The project reports playing levels 1–3 and the first boss with sound and saves. The iOS build has not been tested on a physical device.
listing.original_game_title: Blade II: The Return of Evil

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own XCI and prod.keys, or extracted ExeFS and RomFS. The project’s example uses title 01009cc00e224000 with update v131072. Other accepted versions are unconfirmed.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Follow the Mac source guide to prepare the game modules and shaders locally, then use mac_app_blade.sh to create an app or disk image. The project has no published player package.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports Mac cutscenes, controller input and 60 FPS in the tested levels. Its iOS shell compiles for ARM64. Windows and Linux routes are unconfirmed.
